description: Labelled questions for automatic business-intent detection. 'business' = should start business insights automatically (industry is the expected normalized sector, or null when none is named); 'research' = academic or technical, must stay research-only; 'optional' = ambiguous, must not start automatically. The heldout split was written with the dev split, before the parser was changed, and is not used for tuning.
